frozen_after_pilot: data/instance-probe-v1-001 visual QA and v2 raw audit; new v3 audits bind geometry source and support envelope. No model or perception thresholds changed.
box_definition: tight visible-instance xyxy with exclusive max; amodal geometry retained separately
truncated_objects: retain when other gates pass, tag separately
occlusion: unknown unless measured by a controlled intervention; bbox fill is not visibility fraction
rider: union raw 13 with body raw 18/19 only for same verified actor instance ID; rider-only two-wheelers are ignored
not_visible: no positive box and no projected-amodal ignore box
unknown_or_unsupported_foreground: preserve raw instance/semantic masks and export explicit ignore mask + conservative per-ID boxes; never implicit background
temporary_obstacles: not assigned from broad static/dynamic tags; requires blueprint-specific verified taxonomy and coverage in a new policy
background_ignore_proposal_rule: background labels only: ignore if proposal center is in an ignore box or intersection/proposal_area > threshold; positive matches keep precedence
training_approval: requires natural dataset acquisition/audit, stratified visual QA, complete foreground coverage or an ignore-aware trainer, frozen group splits and class/episode quotas. Controlled probe exports are always training_approved=false.
revision_reason: Keep actual amodal and observed visible boxes unchanged. Validate mask extent with the same 0.15m OBB tolerance used for depth, rather than discarding legitimate mirror/mesh extent at image edges. Prior v1 exports retained.
